create.name: Shaila Catherine
create.bio:
Shaila Catherine is an American Buddhist meditation teacher and author, best known for her guidance on concentration and the deep absorption states called jhana. She began meditating in 1980, spent much of the 1990s practising abroad with teachers such as H.W.L. Poonja and Buddhadasa Bhikkhu, and has built up more than nine years of silent retreat, including a ten-month jhana retreat in 2004. Between 2006 and 2014 she trained in samadhi and vipassana with Venerable Pa-Auk Sayadaw of Myanmar, completing his full course twice. Her own teaching began in 1996 and has taken her to Europe, Israel, New Zealand and Canada as well as across America.

She founded Insight Meditation South Bay, a meditation community in Silicon Valley, and Bodhi Courses, an online classroom that runs two structured courses a year mixing recorded talks, sutta readings and live video meetings. Locally she leads monthly half-day sittings in Los Altos and Los Gatos, and she also teaches residential retreats across the United States. Her books are The Jhanas (first published as Focused and Fearless), Wisdom Wide and Deep, a handbook based on the Pa-Auk method, and Beyond Distraction, on the Buddha's five ways of working with unwanted thoughts. She has also worked with researchers studying the effects of deep concentration.

books.title: The Jhanas: A Practical Guide to Deep Meditative States
books.author: Shaila Catherine
books.description: A guide for everyday meditators to the concentrated absorption states of the Buddhist path, with exercises, examples and practical advice. It is a new edition of her first book, Focused and Fearless.

books.title: Wisdom Wide and Deep: A Practical Handbook for Mastering Jhana and Vipassana
books.author: Shaila Catherine
books.description: A detailed handbook to the jhana and insight training taught by Pa-Auk Sayadaw, who asked her to write it. It moves from building stable concentration to close investigation of mind and matter.

books.title: Beyond Distraction: Five Practical Ways to Focus the Mind
books.author: Shaila Catherine
books.description: Five methods, drawn from a discourse of the Buddha, for handling thoughts that pull attention away, illustrated with examples from her students. It is written for beginners and experienced meditators alike.

courses.title: Monthly Saturday Half-Day Meditation
courses.description: An afternoon of meditation and teaching held one Saturday a month, alternating between Los Altos and Los Gatos. The current series works step by step through mindfulness with breathing.

courses.title: Beautiful Mind: Cultivating The Five Spiritual Faculties
courses.description: A Bodhi Courses online course on faith, energy, mindfulness, concentration and wisdom as a framework for meditation, with readings, recorded talks and optional Sunday video meetings with her.

courses.title: Insights into Emptiness: Meditations on the Six Senses
courses.description: A new online course that uses the six sense doors as a frame for insight practice, looking at how experience is known without the overlay of a self.

courses.title: Qualities of a Liberated Mind: Awakening Factors in Concentration and Insight
courses.description: A ten-day residential retreat at the Calvin Center near Atlanta, Georgia, on the seven factors of awakening as they develop in both concentration and insight practice. It is meant for people with some mindfulness experience.
courses.price: $3,300–$3,900 USD sliding scale (10 nights, room and meals)

free_resources.title: Audio Teachings
free_resources.description: A list on her site of free podcast conversations and recorded sessions with guided meditations and Q&A, on jhana, distraction and concentration.

free_resources.title: Video Teachings
free_resources.description: Recorded talks and a panel discussion on deep states of concentration, free to watch.
